hook_text: They call me the Science Queen. Watch what I do to Conservation of Energy.
clip_script: They call me the Science Queen. I teach Physical Sciences at Supacharge. Today, we are conquering the Conservation of Mechanical Energy. The principle states that in an isolated system, the total mechanical energy is constant. Mathematically: $(E_k + E_p)_i = (E_k + E_p)_f$. If I drop a 2 kg ball from 5 m, initial velocity is zero, so initial kinetic energy is zero. Final height is zero, so final potential energy is zero. The equation simplifies beautifully: $98 = v_f^2$. Take the square root, and we get $9,90 \text{ m\cdot s}^{-1}$. Pure discipline. Four marks secured.
